count_definition: 11 distinct visible receipt/invoice documents in 10 images from 10 source pages; RB-02 and RB-03 are separate receipts in the same image. Not 15 per merchant, not a measured OCR benchmark.
limitations: Public images from 2016–2025, not verified current layouts for every chain.
Not all documents are complete scans or original electronic files; authenticity and digital signatures were not verified.
No raw receipt images, buyer identities, membership IDs, card references or receipt identifiers are copied into this catalog.
Public visibility does not establish training/redistribution permission.
Makro has one directly inspected receipt in this first pass; CJ full invoice and all brands current end-to-end recovery examples remain gaps.
Five merchant electronic channels are guidance records, not additional receipt examples; zero original electronic files or cryptographic checks in this pass.

samples.source_locator: whole receipt; bottom extends beyond viewport
samples.observed_facts: 199.00 gross; five reductions 1.00/5.00/20.25/5.00/9.75; net 158.00; savings summary 41.00; zero-price game/reward row
samples.design_implication: Do not subtract savings summary again or multiply discount amounts by the left-side count; reward counter is not merchandise quantity.

samples.observed_facts: Two goods 54.00 + 14.00 = 68.00; cash tendered 500.00; change 432.00; VAT Included text
samples.design_implication: Cash tendered is not expense amount; VAT Included does not authorize a second VAT addition or input-tax claim.

samples.source_locator: app screenshot of full-format document; fine print not fully transcribed
samples.observed_facts: Buyer block is redacted by publisher; item table, discount breakdown, VAT summary and document legend visible
samples.design_implication: A screenshot of an electronic invoice is not cryptographic validation of its original file; link to original purchase, do not create another expense.

samples.source_locator: receipt at right; product labels at left
samples.observed_facts: 16.00 + 58.75 + 58.75 = 133.50; cash 200.00/change 66.50; adjacent product labels show 58.50; footer advertises coupon up to 320
samples.design_implication: Segment receipt vs product label and future promotion; preserve conflicting sources rather than repair the bill from a shelf label.

samples.observed_facts: 227.00 before promotion; 5.00 promotion also repeated as savings summary; total 222.00; coins 44.00 + M/C 178.00; change 0.00; remaining coins 45.32
samples.design_implication: Keep document total, settlement components and remaining rewards separate; employee reimbursement policy for personal coins remains undecided.

samples.observed_facts: 59.00 sale, -59.00 VA row, 53.00 corrected sale; Total 53.00; cash 59.00/change 6.00; Vatable 53.00 and VAT 3.47 with VAT INCLUDED
samples.design_implication: Negative cancellation is not a generic coupon or later refund; printed Vatable here is not automatically net taxable base.

samples.source_locator: left receipt in two-receipt photo; footer partly cropped
samples.observed_facts: Long item list with quantity/unit continuation lines and several negative promotion rows; total and card amount 1198.50
samples.design_implication: Do not merge adjacent receipts or count quantity-detail rows as extra products; this is an old layout reference, not a current price or dispute finding.

samples.source_locator: right receipt in same photo; distinct document/time
samples.observed_facts: Total 839.00; CPN row 130.00; CASH 709.00; lower savings text repeats 130.00
samples.design_implication: 839 = 130 + 709 is observable; coupon accounting/funding meaning needs evidence/policy, not an automatic extra deduction or cash-only reimbursement.

samples.source_locator: full document with publisher-redacted buyer block; highlighted weight rows and tax table
samples.observed_facts: Quantity/weight, unit packs, pack price and VAT code columns; weights 0.244 and 0.118; tax table code 1 at 0.00 and code 2 at 7.00; base 32.25 + 3967.29, VAT 277.71, total 4277.25; cash 4500.00/change 222.75; references replacement of abbreviated receipt
samples.design_implication: Tax code is not tax rate; exempt and taxable goods coexist; pack size is not an extra multiplier. Full document replacing a short receipt is one purchase, not another expense.

samples.source_locator: whole receipt including cafe queue footer
samples.observed_facts: Item 45.00; zero-value AIS coupon row; applied AIS promotion -10.00; total 35.00; cash 40.00/change 5.00; cafe queue 21
samples.design_implication: Zero-value coupon row and applied discount are different; queue number is not receipt ID or item quantity; brand/sub-brand should not override legal issuer.

samples.source_locator: receipt image 1; redirects to signed CDN image
samples.observed_facts: 3 units total 30.00; promotion -2.00; total/card 28.00; current points 1, balance 296 and expiring 260
samples.design_implication: Points are counts, not current money; card reference does not identify actual employee payer.

electronic_channels.observed: Account/order history/order details offers electronic full invoice PDF download, retrospective request and correction; page states seven-day request/correction window from payment and 24-hour processing.
electronic_channels.limitation: Channel-specific instructions; no authenticated download, original PDF or signature check. Do not apply timing to all 7-Eleven channels.

electronic_channels.channel: Specified marketplaces and historical store guidance
electronic_channels.source_period: Form accessible on review date; poster Jan-Feb 2025
electronic_channels.observed: Marketplace e-Tax form describes delivery by email; historical official poster directs missing-document recovery via Junk Mail and Tax box, with correction guidance.
electronic_channels.limitation: Form and campaign scopes differ; no current all-store flow or actual e-Tax file checked.

electronic_channels.source_period: Jan-Feb 2025 campaign, despite image directory named 2023
electronic_channels.observed: Store poster asks for abbreviated receipt and identity card, email or phone, then waiting for electronic invoice; separate online campaign conditions shown.
electronic_channels.limitation: Historical guidance, not current delivery SLA or original e-Tax specimen; merchant identity requirements do not authorize identity-card collection in Mangmee.

electronic_channels.source_period: Terms accessible on review date; poster Jan-Feb 2025
electronic_channels.observed: Terms clause 15.5 discusses seller-issued receipt/electronic invoice and document-format restrictions; historical poster covers stores and Makro PRO.
electronic_channels.limitation: Marketplace seller is not necessarily Makro; no actual original electronic receipt file or validation.

electronic_channels.observed: Guide describes member-linked LINE OA form for e-Tax with campaign-specific abbreviated-receipt return requirements.
electronic_channels.limitation: Current 2026 delivery format, end-to-end flow and full electronic invoice specimen remain unverified.

additional_primary_reference.observed: e-Tax Invoice by Email uses time stamping and prescribes PDF/A-3; scanned paper is not the electronic issuance process; email evidence matters.
additional_primary_reference.design_implication: Separate extraction from method-specific verification and accounting eligibility; retain original evidence. Do not infer validation from file extension or AI confidence.
